title: 55. Can I edit an existing translation online?
intent: This article helps EUSurvey survey managers understand or perform the task: Can I edit an existing translation online.
short_answer: Yes! Open your survey, go to the 'Translations' page and select one or more translations to edit. Select 'Edit Translations' from the action menu just above the list of available translations and click on the 'OK' button. This will open the online translation editor that will allow you to edit multiple translations at a time. Please click the 'Save' button to make sure that your changes are written to the system.
procedure: In order to edit only one translation, open your survey, go to the 'Translations' page and click on the pen icon in the 'Actions' column.
